{"command":"python - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
rh=Decimal('130'); oh=Decimal('9'); hr=Decimal('23.1'); om=Decimal('1.73'); wr=Decimal('0.2137'); d=Decimal('138')
g=rh*hr+oh*hr*om
n=g*(1-wr)-d
q=Decimal('0.01')
print('gross exact',g,'rounded',g.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print('net exact',n,'rounded',n.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print('net from rounded gross',(g.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)*(1-wr)-d), 'rounded', (g.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)*(1-wr)-d).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
PY"}
